proposals.title: Deterministic remaining-mass futility for a fixed fitted AST candidate
proposals.admission: No admitted new quality-search mechanism; useful total-cost evidence missing
proposals.mechanism: On a separately authorized future selection block, freeze finite AST/model/prediction identities and W, process whole users in a fixed label-blind order, and retire a candidate only when worst-case remaining positive-query mass cannot reach a declared necessary finite-point improvement threshold. No early promotion, untested-AST retirement, extra fit or refill.
proposals.testable_prediction: Strongly harmful fitted candidates may avoid remaining metric work while preserving finite practical-threshold rejection. Weak/zero differences and rare support can require essentially full evaluation; total cost may increase once prepass/checkpoints are charged. No already-paid fits are saved.
proposals.nearest_source_free_experiment: Exhaustive exact-rational bounded sequences {−1,0,1} for N<=6, every prefix and unknown-denominator completion; compare envelopes/retirement to full finite oracle. Add whole-user boundaries, no-positive/undefined cases, late rescue, unequal user weights and threshold equality; include an operation ledger where fits/sealed predictions dominate.
proposals.benefit_task1: Make a limited automatic candidate-evaluation stop auditable without pretending sparse feedback identifies calibrated AST utility. Result would concern finite-decision preservation and metric cost; it does not determine when to stop all feature generation or establish better ranking.

bound.known_N: N=total mature positive queries; n=processed positive queries; S=sum paired d; M=N-n; L=(S-M)/N,U=(S+M)/N
bound.unknown_N: R=remaining mature queries, all possibly positive; for n+R>0 use[(S-R)/(n+R),(S+R)/(n+R)]
bound.no_observed_positive: [-1,1] while any positive completion remains possible
bound.N_zero: Conditional metric undefined; no promotion certificate
bound.numeric_contract: Exact rational probe only; real reference floating arithmetic needs outward-safe bounds including accumulation/evaluator error. NaN/range/integrity failures stop; no clipping or roundoff retirement.
bound.guarantee_scope: Deterministic finite evaluated population, independent of user dependence; no confidence level or population generalization

executed_literal_evidence.runtime: System python3 stdlib fractions/itertools/statistics/json; no labels/prediction/ML objects or project imports
executed_literal_evidence.known_N_bound_construction: For each N1..6 and each tuple in product((-1,0,1),repeat=N), inspect n0..N. Truth=sum(tuple)/N, S=sum(prefix), M=N-n. Assert (S-M)/N<=truth<=(S+M)/N and U<threshold implies truth<threshold.
executed_literal_evidence.unknown_N_construction: For each same tuple/prefix, inspect R from M through6-n and envelope[(S-R)/(n+R),(S+R)/(n+R)] whenever denominator>0.
